name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U) was launched on 25 June 2015 by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, Government of India with the vision of Housing for All. The scheme provides pucca houses to eligible urban households, addressing urban housing shortages especially for EWS, LIG and MIG categories, including slum dwellers. The mission covers statutory towns and notified urban areas as per Census 2011. Aadhaar is mandatory for eligible beneficiaries.
benefits: BLC & AHP: Central Government assistance varies by State/UT. For Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, UTs of Jammu and Kashmir, Puducherry and Delhi: Central Government ₹2.25 lakh per unit and State Government minimum ₹0.25 lakh per unit. For all other UTs: Central Government ₹2.50 lakh per unit. For all other States: Central Government ₹1.5 lakh per unit and State Government minimum ₹1.00 lakh per unit.
ARH: Technology Innovation Grant of ₹3,000 per square metre per unit from the Central Government and ₹2,000 per square metre per unit from the State Government, as stated in the supplied source.
ISS: Home Loan Subsidy of up to ₹1.80 lakh actual release per unit by the Government of India as a Central Sector Scheme.

rules.description: The family must identify as one of the specified income categories: EWS with annual income up to ₹3,00,000; LIG with annual income ₹3,00,001 to ₹6,00,000; MIG-1 with annual income ₹6,00,001 to ₹12,00,000; or MIG-2 with annual income ₹12,00,001 to ₹18,00,000.
The applicant or family members must not own a pucca house in any part of the country.
The family must comprise husband/wife and unmarried children.
The town/city in which the family resides must be covered under the scheme.

exclusion_rules.description: The family must not have previously availed benefits of any housing-related scheme set up by the Government of India.
